Overview

Pasto is a city in NA with a population of 400,000. A highland city in southwestern Colombia near the Ecuador border, known for its Carnival of Blacks and Whites. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
